Lessons.Title: Rotation of Axis
ExplanationParagraphs: General conic quadratic Ax²+Bxy+Cy²+Dx+Ey+F=0 can be diagonalized by rotation.
Conic discriminant B²−4AC identifies nondegenerate ellipse, parabola or hyperbola.
To remove xy term choose tan(2θ)=B/(A−C), use atan2 for quadrant.
Rotating axes leaves geometric locus unchanged and turns symmetric quadratic form into eigenbasis.
Check degenerate forms separately; discriminant alone does not prove real nondegenerate shape.
Independent Cool-down: identify the standard conic, state relevant foci/axis features, and verify the equation with an independent point.
